app.name: Welcome
cli.about: Lizarbe welcome: a first-run guide to learn your computer, with live practice.
cli.capitulo: start at a step (0 = boot, 10 = end)
cli.demo: demo mode: runs nothing on the system
cli.bad_capitulo: the step must be a number from 0 to 10
peq.2: Enlarge it to at least {w}×{h} to see the Welcome.
salir.texto: You can pick it up any time from the Omarchy menu (Super + Space › Learn › Welcome) or with “lizarbe-bienvenida”. Should it appear again at the next login?
salir.si: Leave and show it again at the next login
salir.no: Leave and never show it again
ayuda.pie: You can also click the buttons at the bottom with the mouse.
super.esta: This is the Super key (Windows on a PC, ⌘ on a Mac)
super.texto: It sits between Ctrl and Alt. Almost everything on your Lizarbe starts by pressing it together with another key.
reto.menu.pista: hold the Super key (the Windows one) and tap the space bar.
reto.terminal.pista: Super + Enter. If the window appears next to this one, that's the automatic tiling.
reto.escritorio2.pista: Super + 2. The top bar will highlight number 2.
term.bienvenida: You cannot break anything here: only harmless commands are accepted.
term.no_permitida: That command isn't in the demo (so nothing can break). Type “help” to see the ones that are.
term.fallo: The command could not be run.
tel.ampliar: Enlarge the window to see this QR code.
tel.paso1: Install KDE Connect: scan the code
tel.paso2: Open it with the phone on the same Wi-Fi
tel.paso3: Pick your phone below and press Space
tel.no_alcanzable: That phone doesn't answer: open KDE Connect on it and check the Wi-Fi.
tel.aceptar_en_telefono: Accept the pairing request on your phone.
tel.solo_vinculado: First pair a phone that is within reach.
herr.escritorio.d: Windows, monitors, keyboard, mouse, shortcuts, startup apps, night light and language for the whole system.
herr.widgets.d: The top bar: what it shows, where and how; widgets, plugins and idle times.
herr.notificaciones.d: Do not disturb and what shows the notices, so they all look the same.
herr.capturas.d: Where they are saved, which key takes them, whether they are copied to the clipboard and what edits them.
herr.temas.d: Design your own theme: colors, borders, wallpapers and icons, with a live preview.
herr.tienda.d: Install programs by category, without knowing the package name.
herr.centro.d: Software suites, KDE Connect, updates and the state of your computer.
con.escritorios.1: Your Lizarbe has five independent desktops, like five work tables. The programs on each one don't mix with the others.
con.escritorios.2: Super + 1 … 5 jumps between them; Super + Shift + 1 … 5 sends the current window to another desktop.
con.mosaico.1: Windows share the screen on their own without covering each other. Open one more and they all rearrange.
con.mosaico.2: Prefer moving them by hand? Super + T frees it; Super + left click and drag moves it, and Super + right click resizes it.
con.menu.1: Super + Space opens a menu with everything: programs, style, settings, install, update and power. Typing searches.
con.menu.2: If you don't know how to do something, start there: it's almost always in the menu.
con.instalar.1: There are no installers to download from web pages. You install from the menu (Install), with the package finder or with Lizarbe's App Store.
con.instalar.2: You can also turn any web page (WhatsApp, Notion, Canva…) into an app of its own with “Web App”.
con.actualizar.1: Update with omarchy update, or with the circular icon next to the clock when it appears. The system and Lizarbe's tools update together.
con.actualizar.2: Before each update the system takes a snapshot; if anything fails, you can go back from the boot menu.
con.privacidad.1: Your Lizarbe sends no telemetry and carries no trackers, and it needs no antivirus: Linux isolates each program's permissions.
con.privacidad.2: Programs are only installed when you ask, and from signed sources.
con.modular.1: Your Lizarbe is made to be opened: parts can be cleaned, upgraded or replaced.
con.modular.2: Opening the case does not void the warranty. And if you need help, message us on WhatsApp at +51 923 488 910.
atajo.mover: Move the window to a desktop
atajos.siempre: to see them all, any time
guia.leer: Read at your own pace, then press Enter to continue.
guia.lista: Go through the list with ↑ ↓. When you are done, press Enter.
guia.practica.demo: Do this now: {reto} (or press Space to mark it as done)
guia.practica.hecho: All done! Press Enter to continue.
guia.terminal.hecho: Well done, that was your first command. Press Enter to continue.
guia.telefono: Scan the code with your phone. If you don’t have it at hand, press Enter to skip.
guia.telefono.solicitado: Accept the request on your phone.
guia.telefono.sin_kde: KDE Connect is not installed. Press Enter to skip this step.
guia.telefono.puertos: Press F to open the firewall ports.
guia.telefono.hecho: Phone connected. Press Enter to continue.
guia.escritorio: Pick a theme with ↑ ↓ and press Space to apply it.
guia.escritorio.hecho: Theme “{tema}” applied. Press Enter to continue.
guia.configurar: Pick one with ↑ ↓ and press Space to open it (optional).
guia.configurar.hecho: Opened in another window. Press Enter to continue.
ayuda.espacio: Do what the step asks (try, apply, open)
guia.actualizar: Press Space to update now. If you prefer to do it later, press Enter.
guia.actualizar.aldia: Your system is up to date. Press Enter to continue.
guia.actualizar.sinred: Could not check. You can update later from the menu. Press Enter to continue.
guia.actualizar.hecho: System updated. Press Enter to continue.
act.motivo: This keeps everything in sync and opens this guide with its latest version.
act.aldia: Your system is up to date
act.sinred: Could not check for updates (no connection?). Later: Super + Space › Update.
